title: Wire a single-phase consumer unit
description: Candidate must correctly wire a 8-way consumer unit with RCD protection, label all circuits, and pass an insulation resistance test.
assessment_criteria: All live, neutral, and earth conductors correctly terminated
No dead shorts on any circuit

title: Install a basin and waste trap
description: Candidate installs a wall-hung washbasin, connects hot and cold supplies, fits a bottle trap, and tests for leaks at 0.5 bar.

title: Construct a mortise-and-tenon joint
description: Candidate produces a through mortise-and-tenon joint from given timber, achieving a snug fit with less than 0.5mm gap.
